 Search THEBLACKLABEL’s “PERFECT GIRL”: Inside the New K-Horror Movie K-Pop Fans Need to Watch
 lewishooper1 1 hour ago 4 min read Blending the psychological suspense of Black Swan  and Scream , the star-studded horror film follows trainees trapped in a sinister mystery. 
 THEBLACKLABEL PERFECT GIRL Korean horror movie promotional image. ( Thunder Road/CAA Media Finance) 
 PERFECT GIRL is a brand new Hollywood horror film that is about to bring the K-pop fandom and K-drama fandom together, as the Dojeon Media team is already buzzing! 
 This new release will mix intense horror elements inspired by Scream  and Black Swan with upbeat K-pop rhythms and choreography and scary tells. The release is jointly backed by THEBLACKLABEL and Atlantic Records . The question is, though: does PERFECT GIRL   have what it takes to survive the cutthroat industry? 
 About the Movie PERFECT GIRL 
 What makes PERFECT GIRL stand out is that its concept focuses more on the horror /thriller musical aspects, rather than the all-cute singing and dancing of a slightly more stereotypical K-film. Most K-films in the past have tended to be action-packed and involve light humor or feature animation. 
 Part of this brand new Hollywood narrative is that the storyline follows the relatable reality of aspiring trainees fighting to secure their spot in a debut line-up, sadly only to realize that their hopes and dreams turn into a high-pressure survival when a mysterious attack strikes. 
 Sounds interesting, right?! We wonder what dark twists and turns might come up along the way. 
 The Cast of PERFECT GIRL 
 A great thing about this new film is that it breaks the social norms, while still maintaining a great level of talent and charisma. 
 This impressive line-up hosts idols, singers, and on-screen personalities all in one place, and this is why this movie is set to become one of the biggest hits once it's released. Let's take a look at the cast. 
 Jeon Somi :  She is a soloist who is taking a lead role as a trainee who appears to be caught in extreme turmoil. 
 Kim Siyoon :  A Billlie member who is set to add some dramatic weight to the group's fight for survival concept. 
 Park Chaerin :  Former Cherry Bullet member, Chaerin will showcase her acting range in the dark plot and musical concept. 
 Nancy McDonie :  Former Momoland star, who will bring major international presence to the cast. We cannot wait to see more of this part! 
 Ally Nitibhon :  A Thai singer and actress who is set to expand the project's global appeal. 
 Adeline Rudolph : Chilling Adventures of Sabrina  star adding strong dramatic tension. 
 Samantha Cochran :  A rising actress reinforcing the thriller's international crossover lineup. 
 Emily Mei :  A multi-talented creator rounding out the ensemble of trainees in peril. 
 Hollywood Crossover: The Production Behind PERFECT GIRL 
 PERFECT GIRL  marks a major Hollywood release, and for some, an acting debut for K-pop stars including Jeon Somi, MOMOLAND’s Nancy McDonie, and Cherry Bullet’s Park Chaerin. 
 This brand new, slightly gothic K-movie is directed by the one and only Zanybros, founder Hong Won Ki, and produced by Badlands and Thunder Road Films. This joint US-Korea production will bridge Western classic horror with global K-pop culture, and together, turns them into something wonderful! 
 Why Somi Has Joined "Another Girl Group" 
 One question that keeps coming up over and over again is: why is Somi about to join another girl group? 
 Although Somi previously took a break from the K-pop industry, she is not actually about to return to a fixed, permanent K-pop group activity basis with the new band. She is, however, playing a K-pop trainee inside the movie's fictional storyline. 
 For Somi , this is the best of both worlds, as she gets to break into the acting industry while maintaining a presence in music, without stepping away from her established career as a soloist under THEBLACKLABEL . Could we see Somi in the acting world more after this release? We sure hope so. 
 Perfect Girl Release Details 
 Teaser image for the film Perfect Girl . (Zanybros) As of now, the official release dates and information are under lock and key; however, the group's selling point and fictional storyline do serve as a high-stakes climax of a film, and a slight risk within the pretty safe and standard K-film industry. We really cannot wait to see how the storyline and dynamics unfold. 
 Bringing K-Pop Back: Evolution & Identity Crisis 
 With the K-pop scene becoming more inclusive, it does at the same time face somewhat of an identity crisis. Many old and new groups tend to struggle with the balance of incorporating traditional elements with the more Western global appeal. 
 Acts like A20 LITE have said previously that they aim to revive classic K-pop energy and focus on the sense of nostalgia that many of us have come to love in recent years, such as what NewJeans did well. 
 Rookie girl group A2O LITE. (Yonhap News) PERFECT GIRL   does tap directly into these industry pressures and identity struggles trainees face while striving for their debut, and this is one of the reasons why the Dojeon Media team can see them becoming successful within the industry and popular amongst K-pop fandoms and K-drama fandoms. 
 We are interested to see how the group dynamics and chemistry play out in the movie, and what stereotypes or real-life relatable situations may occur, 
 Final Thoughts 
 The Dojeon Media team cannot wait to see what PERFECT GIRL brings to the K-film industry. 
 Although we agree that the K-pop industry is inundated with acts and trainees, we are looking forward to seeing PERFECT GIRL's spin and charisma with a darker gothic theme in a movie setting. 
 The star-studded cast really does promise to deliver an edge-of-your-seat thriller for drama and K-pop and K-drama fans alike, and we will be following the journey!
